question:
Select the phrase/idiom that will improve the underlined part of the given sentence.

After two hours of wandering in the desert, we realised we were on a __wild horse race.__
solution:
The correct answer is** Option 1)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase **"wild goose chase"** means a futile or hopeless search for something that is difficult or impossible to find. (व्यर्थ की खोज)

 
 
• **Example: **The detective was on a** wild goose chase,** trying to find the non-existent treasure.
 
 
 
• **"Wild goose chase" **refers to a situation where one is searching for something that is not likely to be found, often leading to frustration. (व्यर्थ की दौड़)
 
 
• **Example: **After hours of searching for the lost keys, it turned out to be a **wild goose chase.**
 
 

Therefore, the correct replacement of the given statement is **"wild goose chase."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
